# ADR-003: Retain numeric expression order

Status: chosen_for_distance_slice

Concerns: Q-behavior, Q-evidence

## Decision

Evaluate original binary64 multiplication/addition grouping and sqrt, including finite underflow behavior, rather than the scaled vector norm at the three distance sites.

## Rationale

Independent original-header observations detected bit differences. No tolerance relaxation was needed.

## Alternatives

Keep scale-normalized length; permit an arbitrary numeric tolerance.

## Consequences

Current finite admitted-query checks pass exact comparisons in debug and optimized Linux builds. Nonfinite API domains and other platforms remain separate obligations.
